   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Oct 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
            2. _Anne Dlh_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "L’application bug dès la première utilisation. Je ne vous recommande pas d’utiliser une application qui vous indique de consommé que 1400 kCal par jour pour une femme… Vous obtiendrez l’inverse de votre objectif. Vous allez perturber votre corps et votre santé mentale. Et pour certaines, développer des TCA… Bien tenté mais non merci."
            3. _TZwieback_, Sep 30, 2026, 2/5: "The app was working really well until the last big interface change - now it’s next to unusable. Who at MFP decides on user interface design? Sack them and ask your users what they want."
